name: Soul Stroll [2 Player Obby]
desc:
Update: Boss Fight!! And NEW Squid game outfits!

⚠️ This game is designed for 2 players! ⚠️
Grab a friend and take on this chaotic soul-and-body adventure.

👻 Be the Soul or the Human 🫀 — each with unique abilities and roles.
💥 Use the Troll Menu to explode, smite, or slip your partner for laughs (or revenge).
🎁 Like the game + join our group for exclusive rewards! → https://www.roblox.com/communities/35868495/Twin-Flame-Games#!/about

🧺 Customize your ghost and soul bind, and unlock new styles by earning badges as you play.
🕊️ Can you both reach the end without falling apart?

🐞 Found a bug or exploiter? Report it in our community server!

PREMIUM: You get a special tag in chat AND you have the chance to purchase the premium starter pack
